guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: How long should an outbound agency's minimum contract be?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Long enough to see a real result, short enough that you're not trapped if it doesn't work. A 3-month minimum is common in the industry and reasonable: it covers setup, a first real sending window, and enough data to judge performance. Anything requiring a 12-month commitment before you've seen a single result is worth questioning.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: What reply rate should I expect from a good outbound agency?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Ranges vary a lot by channel, industry, and how tightly the ICP is defined, which is exactly why you should ask for a range with context, not a single flattering number. Be more skeptical of an agency that can only produce one client's best month than one that shows you a realistic spread across accounts.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: Should an outbound agency give me strategy, or just execute?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Both, ideally. Pure execution without ICP or messaging strategy tends to produce volume without results. Pure strategy without hands-on execution just leaves you with a plan you still have to run. Ask directly who defines your ICP and messaging, and who's accountable for it if it's wrong.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: What's a red flag when evaluating an outbound agency?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Vague answers to specific questions. If an agency can't tell you plainly who owns your sequences and lists after the engagement ends, what their deliverability setup actually looks like, or what a bad month triggers on their end, that vagueness is the answer.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: What does a B2B lead generation agency in India do?

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: How is B2B lead generation priced in India?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Agencies in India price B2B lead generation in three ways: a monthly retainer, a fee per qualified meeting, or a fee per lead, often with setup costs for domains and tools, plus 18% GST. Compare them on cost per qualified meeting that actually happened, because a low per-lead price often hides poor lead quality.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: Is cold email legal in India?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Cold email to business contacts is legal in India, but personal data handling falls under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Its rules were notified in November 2025 and most obligations apply from May 2027. Commercial calls and SMS fall under TRAI rules instead. Ask any agency for its written approach and get legal advice for large campaigns.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: How long before a lead generation agency books the first meeting?

The setup weeks go to ICP definition, list building, domain warm-up and copy. An agency promising meetings in week one is usually skipping one of those steps.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: Should I pay per lead or pay a retainer?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Pay per lead suits you when you only want contacts and will run the outreach yourself. A retainer or per-meeting model suits you when you want the agency to run the whole system, because it rewards them for testing, fixing deliverability and improving copy instead of maximising the number of contacts delivered.

lp-financial-services.question: Which job titles do you typically target?

lp-financial-services.question: How long before we see our first qualified meetings?

lp-financial-services.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?

lp-fundraising.question: Do you get us warm intros, or is this cold outreach?

lp-fundraising.answer: A raw database gives you names and firms. It doesn't tell you which partner is actively deploying right now, whether your check size and stage actually fit their fund, or how to personalise the first message so it doesn't read like every other founder's cold email. We build the filtered list and run the full outreach system around it.

lp-fundraising.question: Do you help with the pitch deck or the fundraising narrative?
lp-fundraising.answer: No. Our focus is investor targeting and outreach, getting the right conversations booked, not deck design or narrative coaching. Bring a raise-ready story and we'll get it in front of the right investors. If your materials are not ready yet, it is usually better to fix them before outreach starts.

lp-fundraising.question: What if I don't know exactly which investors are the right fit yet?
lp-fundraising.answer: That's the first step, not a prerequisite. We build your investor ICP with you, based on stage, sector, geography and cheque size, before any outreach goes out. Agreeing that profile first means outreach only goes to investors who back companies at your stage and in your sector.

lp-fundraising.question: Is this only for a specific funding stage?
lp-fundraising.answer: No. It is built to flex from pre-seed and seed through Series A and B. lp-fundraising.question: How fast can this be live?

lp-insurance.question: How is this different from cold calling or relying on referrals?

lp-insurance.question: How do you handle renewal-cycle timing?

lp-insurance.question: Does this work for group health insurance as well as commercial or property lines?
lp-insurance.answer: Yes. The system adapts to your book, whether that is group health, commercial property and liability, or keyman and corporate liability cover. lp-insurance.question: We already have a BD or relationship management team. Will this overlap?
lp-insurance.answer: No. We focus purely on generating net-new outbound conversations with companies you do not already have a relationship with. Your BD and RM teams keep managing existing accounts and referral relationships; we add a new, always-on channel for fresh corporate business.

lp-insurance.question: How soon can we expect our first meetings?

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: How can Indian manufacturers find international buyers between trade shows?

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Do you work with our specific product category?

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: How do you make sure buyers are serious and not just price shopping?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We target named procurement heads, sourcing managers and importers directly, chosen by company size and buying signals, instead of broadcasting to anyone who fills a form on a B2B portal. Outreach asks about real requirements, such as volumes and certifications, so price-only enquiries are easy to spot early.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Which countries and regions can you target?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We have run outreach across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia, including Germany, France and the UAE. Tell us your target markets and we build the prospect list and messaging around them, with sends timed to each region's working hours and copy that reads naturally to buyers there.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Do you handle the language and cultural side of outreach in different markets?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: Yes. Messaging tone and structure are adjusted per region, and we can localise outreach where needed so it reads naturally to buyers in that market. lp-pharma.question: How do Indian pharma companies find distributors and buyers abroad?

lp-pharma.question: Does Myntmore handle regulatory approvals or compliance for us?

lp-pharma.question: How does outreach differ for domestic buyers versus export and global buyers?

Export and contract-manufacturing outreach targets importers, sourcing heads, and procurement teams abroad, with messaging built around therapeutic category fit and manufacturing capacity. We run both as separate, tailored tracks.

lp-pharma.question: How do you handle compliance-sensitive messaging in outreach?

Every sequence is approved by your team before it goes out, and any compliance question a buyer raises is flagged and routed straight to you.

lp-pharma.question: Which buyer titles and roles do you typically target?
lp-pharma.answer: Procurement heads, regulatory affairs contacts, import and export managers, hospital purchase committee members and distribution partners. lp-recruitment-firms.question: How do executive search firms win new mandates?

lp-recruitment-firms.question: How is this different from job boards and referrals?

lp-saas-founders.question: Should a SaaS startup hire SDRs or outsource outbound?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Outsource first if you have not yet proven which segment and message book meetings: an agency can test that from its existing infrastructure, while a new SDR needs time to ramp and still needs a playbook. Hire in-house once outbound reliably converts and someone can manage the team. Many companies run both side by side.

lp-saas-founders.question: How is this different from tools like Apollo or Clay that we already use?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Those tools give you data and automation. We give you a fully managed system: ICP mapping, signal-based targeting, copywriting, sequencing and deliverability, run by a team that adjusts it every week based on what is working. Data alone rarely books meetings; what you do with it each week does.

lp-saas-founders.question: Will this work if we are still pre-product-market fit?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Outbound works best once you have a handful of paying customers and a clear picture of who gets value fastest. If you are very early, we will tell you honestly and suggest a smaller pilot, which can still be useful for testing which segments respond before you scale.

lp-saas-founders.question: How do you avoid spam filters and protect our sender reputation?
lp-saas-founders.answer: We set up dedicated sending domains and inboxes, separate from your main domain, and warm them up before any campaign sends. SPF, DKIM and DMARC are configured on every domain, volumes stay within strict daily limits, and inbox placement is monitored, so your core domain's reputation is never at risk.

lp-saas-founders.question: Do you integrate with our CRM, like HubSpot or Salesforce?

lp-saas-founders.question: We already tried outbound once and it did not work. Why would this be different?

service-account-based-marketing.question: How is this different from your other lead generation services?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Our other services (cold email, LinkedIn outreach, AI lead gen) are built to generate volume across a broad ICP. ABM flips that: you give us a defined, finite list of named accounts you specifically want to win, and we run coordinated campaigns to engage multiple people inside each one, not just cast a wide net.

service-account-based-marketing.question: How many accounts can this realistically cover?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Most engagements run 50 to 250 named accounts, tiered by priority. Tier 1 accounts (your highest-value targets) get the most coordinated, multi-stakeholder attention; lower tiers run on a lighter cadence. The right number depends on your team's capacity to follow up once accounts start engaging.

service-account-based-marketing.question: Which channels are included?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: LinkedIn outreach and email are the core channels, run in a coordinated sequence against the same account list rather than as separate campaigns. Where it fits your budget and audience, we can layer in LinkedIn ad retargeting for additional account-level visibility.

service-account-based-marketing.question: How does the handoff to our sales team actually work?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Every account gets an engagement record: who was contacted, on which channel, what they opened or replied to, and how engaged the account is overall. That's delivered to your team as an account-level report, so your AE walks into the first conversation already knowing which stakeholders are warm and why.

service-account-based-marketing.question: What size company or deal size is this built for?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: ABM makes the most sense once your average deal size and sales cycle justify a multi-touch, multi-stakeholder approach, typically mid-market and enterprise B2B deals with several decision-makers involved. For simpler, single-stakeholder sales motions, our LinkedIn outreach or cold email services are usually a better fit.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: What does the AI actually do versus your human team?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: The AI handles research, enrichment, and scoring at scale: pulling data from multiple sources, cross-referencing signals, and ranking leads by fit and intent. Our human team configures the agents, audits output for quality, writes the strategic layer, and makes sure nothing reaches your sales team without being genuinely useful.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How accurate is the lead scoring?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: With a well-defined ICP, our scoring runs at roughly 85 to 90% relevance on the top tier. Every list is checked by people before outreach, and your team flags false positives, which the model learns from. Accuracy improves month over month as it sees which leads actually book meetings.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How do we receive the leads?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: You get clean, structured lead exports with full research summaries attached, mapped to your fields and ready to import into whatever system your team already uses. We don't build or manage CRM integrations, that stays part of your own process.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How many leads can you generate per month?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: For most B2B clients with a defined ICP, we deliver 300 to 1,500 scored, research-enriched leads a month. Volume is never the goal; relevance is. 200 right-fit leads beat 2,000 cold ones, so the number we agree with you depends on your market size and how many conversations your team can take.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: Will this work for a niche industry with a small TAM?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: Often better than broad markets. A smaller TAM means we go deeper on each account, track more specific signals, and personalise outreach at a level generic tools can't. Some of our best results come from clients with a TAM under 5,000 accounts.

service-cold-email.question: How does this work?
service-cold-email.answer: We run cold email end to end in ten steps. First we map your ideal customer profile and build a targeted lead list, then write the copy and set up domains, inboxes and DNS. After launch we handle follow-ups, A/B testing, nurturing replies into meetings, and real-time reporting.

service-cold-email.question: How do we measure success?
service-cold-email.answer: We measure four things: deliverability, reply rates, meetings booked and conversions. You get real-time tracking and regular reports, so you always see what is working. The targets we aim for are 90%+ email health, a 1%+ reply rate and 20%+ positive replies.

service-cold-email.question: What's the timeline?
service-cold-email.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of onboarding. That window covers domain and inbox setup, warm-up, building your lead list and writing the copy. First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we optimise.

service-cold-email.question: Who sees the best results?
service-cold-email.answer: B2B businesses see the best results, particularly service providers, SaaS companies, agencies and consultants. These teams sell to a clearly defined set of business buyers, so a targeted list with every prospect handpicked, plus relevant soft-sell copy, starts conversations with exactly the right people.

service-cold-email.question: How many leads can I expect?
service-cold-email.answer: Clients typically see 1–3% reply rates, with consistent meetings by weeks 6 to 8. Volume depends on your list and offer: the package sends up to 1,200 emails a day to 5,000 fresh prospects a month, and results improve as we test copy and targeting. Some campaigns convert at 4x the industry average.

service-do-it-yourself.question: How is this different from your Done-for-You LinkedIn Outreach service?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Done-for-You means our team builds and manages your entire LinkedIn outreach strategy, copy, and execution for you. Do It Yourself is the same underlying automation, but you're in the driver's seat: you log in with your own LinkedIn account, build your own campaigns, write your own notes and follow-ups, and run it yourself from your own dashboard.

service-do-it-yourself.question: Whose LinkedIn account does this run on?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Yours. You log in with your own LinkedIn account, and every campaign you build runs from that account. Nothing is handed over to us, and we don't send messages on your behalf. That also means connection requests and replies stay in your own inbox, where you can answer them directly.

service-do-it-yourself.question: Can I run more than one campaign?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Yes. Each campaign has its own list of leads, connection note and follow-up sequence, so you can run several at once for different segments, offers or lists. Running them side by side also lets you compare acceptance and reply rates and keep the messages that work.

service-do-it-yourself.question: What can I configure for my follow-ups?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: For every campaign, you set how many follow-up messages go out, what each one says and the delay before each one is sent. Follow-ups only go to people who have accepted your connection request, so you can write them as a natural continuation of the first note.

service-do-it-yourself.question: What do I see on my dashboard?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Both campaign-level and lifetime metrics: acceptance rate, reply rate and the live status of every lead in every campaign. That makes it easy to see which connection notes and follow-ups are working, and which campaigns need a new list or new copy.

service-do-it-yourself.question: How do I get access?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Book a demo with our team and we'll get you set up. On the call we show you how campaigns, follow-ups and the dashboard work, and help you set up your first campaign. If you would rather have the whole system run for you, we can talk about our managed LinkedIn outreach service instead.

service-gtm-strategy.question: What exactly is included in a GTM strategy engagement?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: ICP definition, competitive and market mapping, a channel mix and sequencing plan, a messaging framework, and a direct handoff to execution across whichever channels fit, cold email, LinkedIn, ABM, or personal branding. It's a plan built to be run, not a deck.

service-gtm-strategy.question: Do you also execute the strategy, or just hand over a plan?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Both. The same team that builds the GTM strategy runs it across the channels you choose, so there's no handoff gap between "strategy" and "execution" like there is when a consultant hands a plan to a separate agency and disappears.

service-gtm-strategy.question: How is this different from your other services, like Cold Email or LinkedIn Outreach?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Those are channel-specific execution services. GTM Strategy is the layer above them: it decides which channels to prioritise, what your ICP and messaging should be, and how they should sequence together, then feeds directly into whichever of those services you need.

service-gtm-strategy.question: How long does the initial strategy phase take?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Typically 2 to 3 weeks for the audit, ICP work and channel plan. Because the same team then runs the plan, the first campaigns can go live straight after, in line with our other engagements, where campaigns go live within 18 days and first conversations follow in weeks 3 to 4.

service-gtm-strategy.question: What if we already have a GTM strategy but it's not working?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: That's a common starting point, not a blocker. We audit what's already running, including channels, messaging and results, find where the current plan is leaking, and rebuild the parts that need it rather than starting from zero. Often the fix is a narrower ICP or a sharper offer, not a new channel.

service-gtm-strategy.question: Is this only for early-stage startups?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: No. It fits any B2B company changing its go-to-market: a new ICP, a new market, a stalled channel, or scaling what already works. Stage changes the specifics of the plan, not the process. An early startup needs its first repeatable segment; a larger company usually needs a new market or channel.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: Why do I need to build a personal brand?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: People buy from people they recognise and trust. A strong personal brand puts you in front of buyers before your first message, makes your outreach credible and gives you pricing power: 45% of a company's market value ties back to leadership reputation, and buyers pay 13.57x more to those they see as experts.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: Why LinkedIn?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: LinkedIn is where you can reach named decision-makers directly, by role, company and seniority. Personal profiles get far more reach than company pages, so content from you builds trust while outreach starts the conversations, and both happen in the same place your buyers already check before replying.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: What's in it for me?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: A steady pipeline of conversations and qualified meetings, a profile and content that make your outreach credible, and a calendar that fills consistently, for about 90 minutes of your time a month. That time goes into one content interview and reviewing what we write; we handle the rest.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: How do AI agents fit into the process?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: They work like a research team in the background. They break down your ICP, rank who is most likely to engage, enrich every lead with context, track your competitors, and draft comments, replies and follow-ups in your voice. service-linkedin-outreach.question: What makes AI agents so effective for LinkedIn?

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: What is a LinkedIn hook?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: The opening lines of a LinkedIn post, the part shown before the "see more" cut. How much shows depends on the device, usually two to three lines. For many readers, those lines decide whether the rest gets read, so a strong hook is the cheapest way to improve a post's reach.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: How is the score calculated?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: Six rules are checked in code: length, curiosity, specificity, authority, action and a clickbait penalty. They add up to 100. The same wording always gets the same score, and the AI never sets it, so you can edit a hook, re-check it and see exactly what changed.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: What does the AI do?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: Google's Gemini writes three alternative hooks, each from a different angle: a specific result, a contrarian take and a curiosity gap. Each alternative is then scored with the same six rules, so you can compare them with your original. The AI only writes; the scoring stays in code.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: Will it make up numbers for my hook?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: No. The rewrites keep your meaning and facts. Where a number would help and you gave none, the tool uses a placeholder such as [X%] for you to fill in with something true. AI output can still be wrong, so read each rewrite before you post it.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: Is a high score a guarantee the post will perform?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: No. The score shows how well the opening follows common hook principles. Reach also depends on your audience, topic, timing and the rest of the post. Use the score to compare versions of the same hook, not to predict how many people a post will reach.
